verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੈ ਸਾਸਿ ਨ ਮਾਸ ਸਨਿ ਅੰਧ ਧੁੰਧ ਕਛੁ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: pirathamai saas na maas san a(n)dh dhu(n)dh kachh khabar na paiee|

en.bdb: First of all, when no breath and body was there nothing was visible in the pitch darkness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਕਤਿ ਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਦੇਹਿ ਰਚਿ ਪੰਚਿ ਤਤ ਕੀ ਜੜਿਤ ਜੜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: rakat bi(n)dh kee dheh rach pa(n)ch tat kee jaRit jaRaiee|

en.bdb: The body was created through the blood (of mother) and semen (of father) and the five elements were joined judiciously.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ ਚਉਥੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: paun paanee baisa(n)taro chauthee dharatee sa(n)g milaiee|

en.bdb: Air, water, fire and earth was put together.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚਮਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਕਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਛਟਮੁ ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਸਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)cham vich aakaas kar karataa chhaTam adhisaT samaiee|

en.bdb: The fifth element sky (void) was kept in between and creator God, the sixth one, invisibly permeated among all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਪੰਚੀਸਿ ਗੁਨਿ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਬਣਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)ch tat pa(n)chees gun satr mitr mil dheh banaiee|

en.bdb: To create the human body, five elements and twenty five qualities opposite to each other were joined and mixed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਚਰਿਤ ਦਿਖਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: khaanee baanee chalit kar aavaa gaun charit dhikhaiee|

en.bdb: Four life originating mines (egg, fetus, sweat-born, vegetation) and four types of speech (para, pasyanti, madhyama, vaikhari) were assimilated into each other and the drama of transmigration was enacted.
Thus eighty four lacs of species were created.
